title: Correlate request lifecycles and anomalies
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for events containing {"time_s":number,"kind":"open"|"close","id":string} and slow_after_s>=0. Track active requests by id. An open for an inactive id records its time; a duplicate open emits {"index":i,"id":id,"code":"duplicate_open"} and leaves the original start unchanged. A close for an active id removes it and appends {"id":id,"duration_s":close-start,"slow":duration>slow_after_s} to completed in close order; an unmatched close emits code "unmatched_close". IDs can be reused after a successful close. Return {"completed":[...],"anomalies":[...],"pending":[sorted active ids]}. Anomalies are in event order. Validate before processing: negative slow_after_s -> {"error":"invalid_policy"}; then any unknown event kind -> {"error":"invalid_kind"}; then any negative or decreasing event time -> {"error":"time_order"}. Equal times and zero durations are valid. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 0, relative tolerance 0; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
